==Purpose of template==
Link to source for a Bible reference.

== Usage ==

<code><nowiki>{{</nowiki></code>Cite/bible|''book''|''chapter''|''verse''|''chapter2''|''verse2''|version=''version''<code><nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>

== Examples ==

{|class=wikitable
!Code!!Result
|-
|<pre>{{Cite/bible}}</pre>||{{Cite/bible}}
|-
|<pre>{{Cite/bible|Genesis}}</pre>||{{Cite/bible|Genesis}}
|-
|<pre>{{Cite/bible|Genesis|2}}</pre>||{{Cite/bible|Genesis|2}}
|-
|<pre>{{Cite/bible|Genesis|2|3}}</pre>||{{Cite/bible|Genesis|2|3}}
|-
|<pre>{{Cite/bible|Genesis|2|3|4}}</pre>||{{Cite/bible|Genesis|2|3|4}}
|-
|<pre>{{Cite/bible|Genesis|2|3|4|5}}</pre>||{{Cite/bible|Genesis|2|3|4|5}}
|-
|<pre>{{Cite/bible|Genesis|2|3||6}}</pre>||{{Cite/bible|Genesis|2|3||6}}
|-
|<pre>{{Cite/bible|Genesis|2|3|4|5|version=KJV}}</pre>||{{Cite/bible|Genesis|2|3|4|5|version=KJV}}
